high_level_description: The image is the cover of a magazine titled "FORTUNE." The issue is dated April 2019, as indicated at the bottom of the cover. The magazine's website, FORTUNE.COM, is also mentioned. The main focus of the cover is a large, close-up photograph of a person's face, which appears to be Mark Zuckerberg, the CEO of Facebook. The face is split into two halves: one side is in color, showing the person with short hair and a serious expression, while the other side is in black and white, giving it a stark, almost surreal appearance.
